src/app.reason: Direct CLI application composition root, command dispatch, and setup workflows; to be decomposed into domain submodules in Phase 3.

src/clients/control.reason: Control socket client protocol handlers, event bridges, and IPC framing for external orchestration.

src/clients/tui.reason: Terminal UI root components, hooks, layout, and session rendering; to be partitioned into submodules as the TUI matures.

src/clients/tui/menus.reason: Interactive modal and settings menus share picker and option contracts. Includes use-menu-interaction.ts, added on main to register all twelve menu handlers in the render commit; duplicating that layout-effect contract risks reviving the input race. Keep it with its callers and lower this ceiling when a cohesive menu group moves together.

src/engine.reason: Core turn execution loop, retry decision classifiers, and prompt assemblers; cohesive turn mechanics across providers.

src/host.reason: Server gateway, socket dispatch, and transport endpoints; combines direct SSE host and control socket routes.

src/model.reason: Model domain types, token usage tracking, and streaming completion contracts; core vocabulary for all provider adapters.

src/model/providers.reason: Loopback, cloud, and local AI provider implementations and fixtures; each provider file implements ModelProvider independently.

src/protocol.reason: Cross-client event envelopes, serialization codecs, and projection types; stable schemas shared by TUI, headless, and ACP.

src/session.reason: Root session directory holds loose session lifecycle, queue, and stream files; burndown planned in #197 and Phase 3.

src/session/conversation.reason: Conversation replay, journal index, and session browsing logic; scheduled for unification with direct store in Phase 3.

src/tools.reason: Root tool exports, execution facades, and adoption registries; bridges system and language tools to the agent runtime.

src/clients/tui/presentation/components/.reason: Verbatim copy of legacy source/components/message/CommandMessage.tsx: tool rows match legacy by construction; splitting it would reintroduce a rewrite to prove. Four lines are the port exception that reads a live render's measured elapsed time (live-tool-age.ts). Three more are the accepted difference that keeps a finished row's status while a decision is open (#136 item 8).
Verbatim copy of legacy source/components/message/command-message-helpers.ts, the parsers and labels CommandMessage and its renderers share.

src/clients/tui/menus/use-subagent-pool-.reason: Port of source/hooks/use-subagent-pool-selection.ts with only imports changed; kept whole so it stays diffable against the legacy oracle.

src/clients/tui/session.tsx.reason: The session wires the composer to the ported legacy menu stack (useMenuStack, double-Escape) and routes every report into the transcript as legacy's addSystemMessage does; that wiring closes over submit, rewind and the viewport, declared later in the same component, so moving it out would add ref plumbing rather than a job seam. The composer's JSX also sits inside ComposerWidth (legacy InputBox's width-0 first frame), which only wraps it, and the command path preserves each menu's composer routing. The approval panel's Escape adds legacy's Stopped line through the viewport (one prop). The menu stack's first-run setup prompt sits under the live divider as legacy BottomArea places it (one line; the gate itself lives in menus/use-first-run-setup.ts). Candidate 2 adds the ported approval prompt host and tasks panel around the hidden composer box (legacy BottomArea order), which the same routing owns. The harness composer acknowledgement waits for the input to remount after an Esc-closed menu (two lines). Issue #221 adds submit-path wiring that has to close over submit's own locals: the /compact branch and the steer-to-auto delivery rule call compactTracker in commands.ts, which owns the in-flight count and outcome notice, and the in-flight draft restore compares against the text as typed so it does not duplicate it.

src/clients/tui/approval-prompt.tsx.reason: Verbatim port of legacy source/components/prompt/ApprovalPrompt.tsx (every approval and ask_user layout and key path); only its data access changed, so it matches legacy by construction.

src/engine/turn-tools.ts.reason: One per-call Execution record carries a call's planning, admission, interaction answers and settlement; the chosen approval grant rides it like the batch-asked answer, so splitting would pass that record across files.

src/app/tool-surface.ts.reason: Builds one agent's tool surface, including session-browser and worker advisory binding. Delegation owns preparation; its injected registry/context ports close over this same surface's workspace, answers and interceptors, so their composition stays here.

src/engine/turn-model.ts.reason: One model step with its recovery loop; candidate 2 joins the replacement-boundary projection with legacy's retry notices and model_retrying observation, which share the loop's state.

src/protocol/wire.ts.reason: The wire type catalogue; candidate 2 adds the task's live tool state fields beside the others, and usage carries OpenRouter's upstream provider.

src/session/conversation.ts.reason: The Conversation's turn driver; candidate 2 keeps both the question-cancel notice (a3) and the cross-turn compaction hold (solo/tools), each closing over the same driver state. Direct admission checks foreign native compaction coverage before accepting a turn, using the same configured provider and history as the driver.

src/session/replay-fold.ts.reason: The replay fold; candidate 2 keeps both cancelled-turn settlings (a3's unstarted calls and tools' in-flight step), which run on the same fold state.
